subject: question about physical activity data retrieved from Fitbits
body:
Dear Sara/Amin,

 

I’ve got a question in relation to physical activity data that we’ll be able to retrieve from Fitbits. We agreed that we can access all physical activity data that is available via fitbit’s web API.

However, we’re now wondering whether it might be possible to develop something more going forward (after the pilot study)? For example, my understanding is that Fitabase offers access to more data than web API. Is this something you’re able to look into?

 

Would appreciate your thoughts on this.

 

Best wishes,

Magda
